data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for selecting Persian (Jalali) dates via a scrollable calendar UI.
data.what_it_does: It displays a customizable Jalali calendar allowing users to pick year, month, and day. The widget supports RTL layout, color styling, and optional confirm button callbacks.
use_when: You need a Persian/Jalali date picker in a Flutter app
You want built‑in RTL support and simple customization
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without native code
avoid_when: You require Gregorian or other calendar systems
You need advanced features like time picking or recurring dates
You need extensive theming beyond basic colors
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to full date‑time pickers
No code‑generation or advanced theming options
